newsitem.title: JAPAN: JBRI maintains AA rating for Nomura, DKB bonds.
newsitem.headline: JBRI maintains AA rating for Nomura, DKB bonds.

text.p: The Japan Bond Research Institute (JBRI) said on Wednesday that it would maintain its ratings for bonds issued by Nomura Securities Co Ltd and Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd (DKB), despite penalties imposed by financial authorities for their roles in a payoff scandal.
The private credit rating firm currently rates the bonds of both Nomura and DKB at AA.
The rating firm pointed out that the negative impact of the penalties on Nomura had already been factored in when it lowered its rating for the brokerage to AA from AA+ on May 27.
The rating firm also said that DKB will be able to withstand the penalties as it has a strong business base and abundant financial resources as one of Japan's major commercial banks.
